principles: one semantic effect maps to one visual primitive
packet motion never adds a moving dash track
comet motion uses one leading packet and three fading echoes without a moving dash track
stream motion never adds a moving particle
packet shape is length-invariant and has no outline
icon-internal arrows remain owned by icon performance contracts

static.meaning: authored line and endpoint marker only

packet-flow.meaning: discrete data, command, event, or result transfer
packet-flow.visual: one solid role-colored borderless dot travels on a static arrow

comet-flow.meaning: explicitly emphasized burst or high-priority transfer
comet-flow.visual: one borderless leading packet travels with three shrinking fading echoes on a static arrow

stream-flow.visual: one moving dashed stroke travels on a static arrow without particles

semantic_rules.when: relation importance is primary or supporting
burst or high-priority transfer emphasis is explicitly requested

mode_rules.readable: semantic-flow coverage first, then importance and authored order
